name: Cursor
priceBand: Free tier; paid plans — check official pricing
bestFor: Daily product work in an AI-native editor, especially multi-file edits
skipIf: You must stay inside JetBrains or you only want cheap autocomplete
limitations: Frontier usage beyond included pool incurs extra cost
summary: A VS Code fork where tab completion, chat, and agents are the editor. The default pick for many full-time builders.
body: Cursor is what happens when an editor is designed around the model instead of bolting a panel onto VS Code. Tab, Composer, and repo-aware chat are the reasons people pay. Copilot is cheaper if you refuse to switch editors. Claude Code is stronger on long unattended refactors if you like the terminal. Many seniors run both: Cursor for the file in front of them, Claude Code for the scary migration. Confirm live tiers on the official pricing page before you invoice a client.
notes: Budget extra for frontier model usage beyond the included pool
Works best if the team accepts a VS Code-shaped workflow
Not a reason to pirate a license. There is a free tier.
